current.text: In category leagues, experts say he is too high in the 30s. Their fair range runs from the mid 40s to about 75. Lloyd would not take him in the top 50 but would take him before 75.
ESPN's category rank of 75 is too low. He is much better than 75th.
He finished 125th in nine-cat last season but 58th in head-to-head.
In an expert auction mock, Josh bought him for 19 USD. Josh had wanted him for under 20 USD.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, so player roles may change.
Lloyd hopes the new coach brings more creativity for Banchero.
He is a projected starter next to Suggs, Bane, Franz Wagner and Carter. That group was very good when it played together.
Last season he took fewer shots, with fewer mid-range shots and lower usage. His assist rate and his share of assisted makes were career highs.
His scoring last season was about the same as in his 2024 All-Star season.
Phil predicts Orlando wins 47 or 48 games and takes the 6th seed.

durable.text: He puts up a lot of points, rebounds and assists. Josh calls him a big assists-plus-rebounds player.
His assists are far above other forwards.
He turns the ball over a lot, about 3 times a game. That is a league outlier.
His steals are weak and his blocks are about average.
He gets too much hate in category leagues. He does not kill the percentages.
Josh says he has improved his free throw shooting to a pretty good level.
His projected FT% of about 75% on 8 attempts a game is still weak for a forward.
He is a much better points league player than category league player. His value is highest in Yahoo points.
He played 72 games last season despite a groin strain.
He should be good for about 70 games.

note: Our league paid 26 USD for him last season. The experts put him around picks 45 to 75 in category leagues, and his Yahoo value is 20 USD. So aim for about 13 to 20 USD (Josh paid 19 USD in a mock) and let someone else pay 26 USD. He fits punt TO and punt FT builds best, because those builds give up little on his weak turnovers and free throws and still get his points, rebounds and forward assists. Early in the season, watch whether new coach Sweeney gives him more shots and usage, and whether his FT% holds near 77%.
